mapper.select: SELECT POST_ID AS postId , USER_ID AS userId , CATEGORY AS category , TITLE AS title , CONTENT AS content , VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount , CREATE_DT AS createDt , UPDATE_DT AS updateDt , ( SELECT COUNT(cc.COMMENT_ID) FROM community_comment cc WHERE cc.POST_ID = cp.POST_ID ) AS commentCnt , ( SELECT u.USER_ROLE FROM users u WHERE cp.USER_ID = u.USER_ID ) as userRole FROM community_post cp;

SELECT CATEGORY_CODE as categoryCode , CATEGORY_NAME as categoryName , DESCRIPTION as description , SORT_ORDER as SORT_ORDER , USE_YN as useYn , CREATE_DT AS createDt , UPDATE_DT AS updateDt FROM community_category
